On the day of Diwali, the ChessBase India Team including Sagar Shah, Amruta Mokal Abhyudaya Ram Himank Ghosh made their way to the Total World Championship Pilot in Budapest. Before Sagar and Amruta took their flight, they stopped at a very special Diwali Party. This little vlog gives you a feel of what it is like to be part of ChessBase India in this journey covering the best events in the world.
Video: ChessBase India
